title: US Coast Guard monitors Western Maui Wildfires Emergency Support Function #10 debris removal operations in Lahaina Harbor, Hawaii
description: Contracted response personnel collect and transfer inner harbor debris to a nearby disposition lot, Oct. 28, 2023, in Lahaina, Hawaii. The Unified Command, comprised of the U.S. Coast Guard, Hawaii Department of Land and Natural Resources, and Hawaii Department of Health, contracted Global Diving and Salvage to conduct salvage and recovery operations at Lahaina Harbor in support of Western Maui Wildfires Emergency Support Function #10. (U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Brandon Hillard)
keywords: Global Diving and Salvage, Coast Guard District 14, Lahaina, ESF 10, Hawaii Wildfires 2023, Coast Guard
